rows.en:
(I invited Yamashiro-sensei to the pool,
but...)

Nice weather today, isn't it,
Yamashiro-sensei?
Sorry for inviting you out of the blue.

What is there to apologize for?
Keeping students company in training
is only natural for a teacher.

Though inviting Hilda or Gary instead
of me might have been more useful.

No, I wanted to ask you,
Yamashiro-sensei.

I see. Then that's fine.
Now, stop dawdling. Let's go.
Ah, wait for me!
rows.notes: Shared with the Christmas party scene (scd_com_618, Yamashiro route), after 'Come on, let's go.'

rows.en:
Changing took me longer than I thought.
I wonder if Sensei's waiting...
So you've come out.
Sorry to keep you waiting.
rows.notes: Shared: the player here, Luca (frd_luk_115) and Shirakawa (frd_myk_001). Neutral.

rows.en: No, don't worry about it.
Th-that's quite a swimsuit, Sensei.

Is it?
I'd say it's perfectly normal...

Warm up properly.
Swimming is harder work than you'd think.
Well then, let's go.

(Phew, I'm beat... How many kilometers
did I swim...?)

That was good training.
You kept up well, too.

I pushed you hard, expecting you to
wear out sooner... You're not bad at all.
I'm impressed.

You must have built up plenty of lactic
acid. Loosen up your body well and get
to bed early.
Well then, I'll see you later.
Okay. Goodbye, Sensei.
Ah, I forgot to mention...

I enjoyed today.
Invite me again when you're free.
(Maybe I'll invite Yamashiro-sensei again.)

(I invited Yamashiro-sensei to the pool,
but...)
Huh? So this is training?
Now, stop dawdling. Let's go.

Changing took me forever.
I wonder if Sensei's waiting...

Um, don't you have anything to say
about my swimsuit?

Hm, let's see...
Wouldn't you be better off wearing
something more focused on function?
What's wrong?
rows.notes: Shared: Yamashiro here and the male player to Hoshimura (frd_yui_108). Neutral.

rows.en: No, it's nothing, really...

(Phew, I'm worn out... How many
kilometers did I swim...?)
(I'll invite Yamashiro-sensei again!)

(Training at the pool with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)
You're early, \p.
Hello, Sensei!
Full of fighting spirit, I see.
Then let's get right to it.
That's a lovely swimsuit again today...

Low water resistance,
and truly comfortable.
Come on, no slacking. Keep stretching.

(Yamashiro-sensei is strict,
but he's a good teacher.)

(Today I'm supposed to take
Yamashiro-sensei out for a meal.)

\p, you're early.
Already here, are you?
Hello. You're early too, Sensei.

Being five minutes early is the most
basic of basics for a working adult.
Still, you have odd tastes.

Surely there are others you could
invite out for a meal.

I'm curious about what kind of person
you are, Sensei.
Heh. You're a strange one.
So, what are we going to eat?
...What's your favorite food, Sensei?
What, you haven't thought about it?

You're hopeless.
And you're the one who invited me.

I like Japanese food.
I'd prefer fish over meat.
Huh~ That kind of fits my image of you.
And what image would that be?

Light and simple, more calm than
active... Something like that?
Hm, so that's the image I give off...

You're always so composed,
Yamashiro-sensei.

In my line of work, I have to
play support to Gary and the others.
Wow~ I'd love to hear more about that!

Then I'll tell you over our meal.
If you haven't picked a place,
is my usual spot all right?

Thanks for the meal.
The fish was really delicious.

It's a fine place that serves rare
wild-caught fish at low prices.

And it costs no more than
what I usually eat...

There are plenty of places that are
pricey and bad, but few that are
cheap and good.

Finding one of those brings
a special kind of joy.

It makes me want to try out
all kinds of places.

Mm, indeed.
Well, it's getting late.
Shall we head home?
Don't stay up late. Get to bed early.

(Yamashiro-sensei's stories were fun,
and the food was delicious.)

(Today's the day I invited
Yamashiro-sensei out for a meal.)
I enjoy talking with you, Sensei.

(Yamashiro-sensei's stories were fun,
and the food was so good~)

(I'm going to Yamashiro-sensei's
usual spot again today.)

Are you sure it's all right for me
to pick the place again today?
Yes, I don't know any places at all...

uncertain: c06297/c06325: Yamashiro's swimsuit is never described ('sugoi mizugi', 'suteki na mizugi'); rendered 'quite a swimsuit' and 'a lovely swimsuit', both teasing, as the player's reactions suggest.
c06311 (female) 'n? kore wa toreeningu?': she had thought of the pool trip as an outing; 'Huh? So this is training?'.
c06351 'tennenmono' read as wild-caught (not farmed) fish, rare on the fleet.
c06289/c06347: Yamashiro names his colleagues bare ('Hilda', 'Gary'), as the Japanese does.
c06305 'sore de wa, mata na' rendered 'Well then, I'll see you later.' to keep it apart from c00339 'Well then, see you.' (sore ja a na).
